Adj #290 registered exactly one re-read condition and it is the opposite drift (back to RIR 4/4 → one more nudge), so nothing fires: no nudge, no revert, hold 145. The point is the slot's intent — §3.A prescribes 2×15 at RPE 7 and §6 carries rear delts in the joint-health band, not the growth band — so this is the one movement in the circuit that is not meant to go near failure; running it to RIR 1/0 buys fatigue the session has no use for, at the end of a day when the pushdown completed a four-set dose for the first time and the laterals posted 73. W20 ask: stop at RIR 3. Alternative reading on record — if 145 genuinely required RIR 1/0, that is accumulated session fatigue, not a week-old load changing; either way the call is hold, and a third point at RIR 3 settles which (Adj #95/#153/#200/#221/#258/#290/#318)
